steps.en: OCMS receives the company data response from the source
steps.id: OCMS menerima respons data company dari sumber data
steps.why_en: The receiving job is switched off in production, and real response content cannot be checked here.
steps.why_id: Job penerima mati di production, dan isi respons asli tidak bisa dicek di sini.

steps.en: Individual owner/partner/director details are received from the data source
steps.id: Particulars owner/partner/director individu diterima dari sumber data
steps.why_en: Only an ID and position code arrive, with no name or address, and the job is off in production.
steps.why_id: Hanya ID dan kode jabatan yang datang, tanpa nama atau alamat, dan job-nya mati di production.

steps.en: Person chosen by offence date and term of appointment
steps.id: Pemilik/partner/director dipilih menurut tanggal offence dan masa jabatan
steps.why_en: Nothing compares the offence date with the person's appointment dates, so no one is picked this way.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang membandingkan tanggal offence dengan masa jabatan orang, jadi tidak ada yang dipilih dengan cara ini.

steps.en: Selected person's details are stored in OCMS
steps.id: Particulars orang yang dipilih disimpan di OCMS
steps.why_en: Only shareholders are saved; board members are deliberately not written to the database.
steps.why_id: Hanya shareholder yang disimpan; anggota board sengaja tidak ditulis ke database.

steps.en: OCMS decides: 1st reminder to Director or 2nd to Owner
steps.id: OCMS memutuskan reminder ke-1 ke Director atau ke-2 ke Owner
steps.why_en: No decision logic exists; after the lookup the notice stage and recipient stay unchanged.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika keputusan; setelah lookup, stage dan penerima notice tidak berubah.
